why: The fishers of Acra-Tiin send fish and salt across the water to the Soulrest port in small boats (Acra-Tiin record, economy).
The watch on Aphon Isle keeps a boat for its supplies. There is no other way off the isle (Aphon Belvedere record, economy).
Archon is a major seaport for the south-east's legal trade. Lighters bring the bayou's rice and fish (Lore:Sea Transportation; Archon record, economy).
Arorha's potters send clay and pots out by boat and bring Thorn's saltrice back (Arorha record, economy).
A great Hist crowns the mound-town. It is the tree to which the eastern villages send their eggs (Aroxhu, Gaweja, Joxhi, Khiar and Renhu records).
The salvage crew sell their finds to Lilmoth's merchants, and there is no other way off the island (Bell Station record, economy).

Blackrose sits at the three-river confluence. Its canoe-men carry the lake's commerce, and Bramman's river runs on to Soulrest (Blackrose and Soulrest records; argonia-4e201-state.md, Southern water).
The raftman takes fares from travellers on the Lilmoth road (Delta Ferry record, economy).
Salt and iron are shipped out from Gideon's quay, and Gideon's council quarrels with Soulrest over who ships the bay's trade (Gideon record).
Gideon's people keep Cyrodiilic habits. The old roads of the plain run from its gate to Gul-Tej, Slough-Point and Soulrest (map, major roads; argonia-4e201-state.md, Gideon).
Gideon is the canon stop of the rootworm line, known by its red clay (Lore:Rootworm; gideon.md). The worm surfaces at the cutting planted in the Hist garden (Gideon record, faith).
Gul-Tej's river boats work the Onkobra line, whose water joins the Panther River's east to Helstrom (Gul-Tej record; argonia-4e201-state.md, the Onkobra line).
The market town on the fork has a caravan yard on the road to Gideon (Gul-Tej record, economy).
The rivers of the interior drain to Helstrom. Raft-men on the Panther River fork bring the city its goods (argonia-4e201-state.md; Helstrom record, economy).

Helstrom's city tree is the heart of the interior's roots. In the lore the capital is reached by rootworm, and its trade is rootworm and raft traffic (argonia-4e201-state.md; Helstrom record, economy).
The confederacy's river ferry is at Inoja, where outsiders deal with the Oxhu-Teeleel (Inoja record).
A Hist stands in a pool at the town's heart, tended by a tree-minder. The northern posts bring their hatchlings to it (Jal-Veesa and Outpost 7 records).
The people of Jarecai guard the nearest Hist to Soulrest. Every Soulrest Argonian who comes inland to hatch, name or bury pays them a toll (Jarecai record).
Julo's ferrymen work the crossing of the braid below Helstrom and trade with Helstrom's outposts (Julo record, economy).
Kharaxos has a river market on the basin's eastern shore, and its people trade with Jarecai (Kharaxos and Jarecai records).
Korydon's boatwrights build shallow-draft boats and trade up the channels to Helstrom, Truowa and Blackrose (Korydon record, economy).
The town's tree-minder tends the tree of the channels between Helstrom and Blackrose, where eggs are laid (Korydon and Nemeon records).
Lilmoth is a major seaport and the market of the delta villages. Large ships anchor out, and lighter-men carry the goods in (Lore:Sea Transportation; Lilmoth record).
The ferry crew carries people and carts across the channel to the island core for a fare (Lujei Ferry record, economy).
Mir-Xal has a river quay where Blackrose-bound goods are loaded (Mir-Xal record, economy).
Noota-Nara sits on the river above Inoja. Its villagers trade their pots and fish down the river (map; Noota-Nara record, economy).
Nundi's people live on rice, fish and the ferry across the strait to the southern island (Nundi record, economy).
Olvani's ferrymen take the Aphon watch's supplies across the strait (Olvani record, economy).
Boatmen pay landing fees at Salaxul's jetty as they work along the south shore (Salaxul record, economy).
Seafalls' pilots know the shoals. The village is the transfer point between Thorn and Archon (Seafalls record, economy).
Shalaia's raft crews carry shellfish and salt out and bring rice and tools back (Shalaia record, economy).
The western road ends here at the broken bridge. The villagers earn their living from the road trade to Gideon (map, major roads; Slough-Point record, economy).
Soulrest is a major seaport of the Southern Sea trade, with Bramman's river running inland to the Blackrose lakes (Lore:Sea Transportation; Soulrest record, economy).
Soulrest's landward gate opens on the old road north to Gideon. The two ports compete overland as well as by sea (map, major roads; Gideon record, hooks).
Stormhold is a minor port, and river traffic is its trade. Its quay is the northern end of the water that runs south to Helstrom (Lore:Sea Transportation; Stormhold record, economy).
Thorn is a minor port, the north-east's harbour for saltrice and the Tear road trade (Lore:Sea Transportation; Thorn record, economy).
The deep-water quay of Lake Ulaish is at Truowa, where the council tolls the lake's boats. Rice, fish and clay come down the lake and goods go back up (Truowa record, economy).
Stone, hardwood and hides from Tsonac go down its river to be sold at Thorn (Tsonac record, economy).
Uluo's raft-masters move the back-water freight between Archon and the Lilmoth delta. The elder takes a share of every raft (Uluo record, economy).
Yulca's raft ferry works the lake toward Truowa (Yulca record).
